tools.name: sound_status
tools.title: Sound
tools.description: The sound output now and its volume: volume (percent), muted, output {name, description}, and every output there is (outputs: name, description, current). The name is what sound_output takes; the description is what the user calls it ("MacBook Pro Speakers", a speaker's room).

tools.name: sound_volume
tools.title: Set the volume
tools.description: Set the volume of the sound output now (0–100, as the volume keys: never louder than 100), mute or unmute it, or both. Answers with the volume and mute after.

tools.name: sound_output
tools.title: Switch the sound output
tools.description: Play the desktop's sound on another output: the speakers, headphones, an AirPlay speaker, a screen. Give its name from sound_status. Bluetooth headphones must be connected first to be listed. A speaker on the network (AirPlay) may be in another room, so the user allows that on screen first.

output.description: The output's name, as sound_status gives it

tools.name: display_status
tools.title: Displays
tools.description: Every screen now: name (eDP-1 is a laptop's own), description, resolution, refresh rate, scale, and what can be set: scales (the ones that keep text sharp) and resolutions. saved_scale and saved_mode are the user's own choices (null: the display's default). A laptop's own panel has its brightness (percent) too.

tools.name: display_brightness
tools.title: Set the screen brightness
tools.description: Set the laptop screen's brightness in percent (1–100; display_status has it now). An external screen sets its own, and then this fails.

tools.name: display_scale
tools.title: Change a display's scale
tools.description: Make everything on one screen bigger or smaller: one of the scales display_status lists for it (others blur text), or auto for the default. The user allows it on Nightdrive's card first; then the card asks whether to keep it, and it goes back by itself in 20 s unless they do, so a screen left unreadable comes back. Answers kept true or false.

scale.title: New scale
scale.description: A number from its scales ("1.5", "2"), or auto

tools.name: display_resolution
tools.title: Change a display's resolution
tools.description: Set one screen's resolution: one of the resolutions display_status lists for it (WxH, at its highest refresh rate), or auto for the display's preferred one. The user allows it on Nightdrive's card first; then the card asks whether to keep it, and it goes back by itself in 20 s unless they do. Answers kept true or false.

resolution.title: New resolution
resolution.description: WxH (2560x1440), WxH@HZ for another rate, or auto

tools.name: network_status
tools.title: Wi-Fi and network
tools.description: Whether networking and Wi-Fi are on, whether the internet answers (connectivity, NetworkManager's last check: full, limited = connected but no internet, portal = a captive portal wants a sign-in, none, unknown = not checked), the active connections (name, type, device), the Wi-Fi network (ssid, signal %) and its link: band, Wi-Fi standard, rate, signal in dBm, IP address, router and the ping to it in ms.

tools.name: network_off
tools.title: Turn the network off
tools.description: Turn Wi-Fi off (what: wifi), or all networking, wired too (what: all). Your own connection goes with it: the user allows it on Nightdrive's card first, then the card asks whether to keep it off, and it comes back on by itself in 20 s unless they do. Answers kept true or false; when kept, you may not be reachable until the user turns it on again.

what.title: Turn off
what.description: wifi: the Wi-Fi radio; all: all networking

tools.name: bluetooth_status
tools.title: Bluetooth
tools.description: Whether Bluetooth is available and on, the devices connected now (name, mac, battery % when the device reports it: headphones, a mouse) and the paired ones.

tools.name: battery_status
tools.title: Battery
tools.description: The laptop's battery: percent, state (charging, discharging, fully-charged, pending-charge), time_left to empty or to full, power_w being drawn, and health (capacity left of the original, %). present false on a desktop.
